concepts.quote: It will not compile: the string has no closing quote, so Java says unclosed string literal.
concepts.why: The answer looks at new code with a missing closing quote. It names the broken rule (a string literal needs a closing quote), says the error happens at compile time, and gives the correct compiler message.
The answer says nothing about statements: not their order, their effect, or the semicolon.
